_comment: The game's audio boundary (docs/OPENAL_MIGRATION_PLAN.md section 1): entry hooks on its sound manager's methods and, for M0's baseline only, on the FMOD API functions it calls. Lifted beside config/r8_hooks.json (tools/r8_lift.sh, tools/setup_pipeline.py). Every hook declines while g_audio_hooks is 0 (the default): the lifted function runs as before.
